scope: U856 receive-edge correction for the experimental host-buffer observer

source.publisher: VEB Funkwerk Erfurt, VEB Kombinat Mikroelektronik
source.title: Mikroprozessorsystem der II. Leistungsklasse: Technische Beschreibung, SIO U856 D
source.status: Informational manual; preface reserves binding specifications to device standards

locators.receiveSampling: PDF page 19, printed page 20, section 4.2.2; synchronous confirmation PDF page 22, printed page 23

findings: U856 manual section 4.2.2 specifies rising RxC sampling in asynchronous x1 mode; synchronous description also specifies rising RxC.
The motherboard D104 inverter makes rising RxC correspond to falling cable clock. The old host observer instead sampled falling RxC to preserve cable-release observation timing.
Host-buffer SERIAL_TX now observes falling keyboard cable clock and SERIAL_RX observes rising buffer-output clock. Cable-only legacy transport remains explicitly separate.

Previously retained host logical comparisons and sampled setup/hold results describe the opposite edge and do not qualify U856 receive sampling. Voltage captures and pulse-width measurements remain evidence for their original circuits.
openWork: Run corrected host service scenarios and verify logical bits and stability at rising RxC.
Qualify corrected closed-board behavior; any older-source run retains the original sampling boundary.
Keep generic buffer thresholds, switching, SIO loading and specimen agreement unqualified.
validation: HDL tests drive different data at rising and falling receive edges, retain unknown data, and distinguish host clock assertion from legacy cable release.
